pass.answer: - Phase 1 mounts one `jobs.db` on `worker-0` and `worker-1`; each wheel loads every job in the file, so both fire every clinic and owners get duplicates.
| 1 | CRITICAL | Plan | A single shared store breaks the SHARD_INDEX split: the two workers both load all jobs and send twice | One store per shard |
- The changelog says a store file serves one Wheel at a time and takes no lock, but compose runs two workers sharing the store file.
| 2 | IMPORTANT | Plan | Sharding is lost once both workers read `/state/jobs.db`: double-sends break AC2 | Separate volumes |
- Two containers on the `reminders-state` volume risk a corrupted jobs.db, since the store has no file lock.
- Sharding by `SHARD_INDEX` does not prevent duplicate sends: both workers load the same job store and fire every job.

fail.answer: - The two workers will not duplicate reminders because each has its own shard.
- Sharing the store across worker-0 and worker-1 is fine.
- A shard rebalance is not a problem here; double-sends are not a concern.
- Phase 3 has no test for a refused gateway request.
- `worker-0` has no health check in compose.
- `worker-1` will not double-send: `SHARD_INDEX` splits the jobs between the two workers.
